key.name: accent-per-workspace
key.description: The shell and Amethystora's apps take the accent of the workspace shown. Other apps keep the theme's.

key.name: workspace-accents
key.description: One of amethyst, iris, sky, lagoon, jade, moss, amber, ember, coral, rose, orchid and slate for each workspace in order, or theme for the desktop's own. A workspace past the list, and anything else in it, takes the desktop's own.

key.name: day-night
key.summary: Light by day, dark by night
key.description: A theme with a light and a dark pair is switched to its light side when the day starts and to its dark side when the night does (ame desktop day-night). A theme without a pair is left as it is.

key.name: day-night-times
key.summary: When the day and the night start
key.description: night-light: Night Light's times (its own hours, or sunrise and sunset where it knows the location; 07:00 and 19:00 where it knows neither). hours: day-starts and night-starts.

key.name: day-starts
key.description: In hours after midnight, as Night Light writes its own (7.5 is half past seven), while day-night-times is hours.

key.name: night-starts
key.description: In hours after midnight, while day-night-times is hours.
